fixes.explanation: Nazarenes? Ooh, I see where your head went, friend. But that name never shows up in this verse. Acts 11:26 says, "The disciples were first called Christians at Antioch." Christians, right there in Antioch, and I bet the people who got the new name were just as surprised as you are.

Samaria? Friend, I looked all over these verses and Samaria is NOT on the guest list. The disciples in Antioch decided to send relief to the brothers living in Judea (Acts 11:29). Then they sent their gifts to the elders with Barnabas and Saul (Acts 11:30). So the gifts travel to Judea, and that's the whole delivery route.
